## Summary

Describe the change and the project behavior it affects.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests pass
- [ ] Documentation and fixtures match the current contracts

## Privacy gate

- [ ] This change contains no real receipt, order, purchase, stock, budget, or household data
- [ ] Any public fixture is synthetic rather than merely redacted
- [ ] No credentials, Cloudflare resource identifiers, private URLs, or personal identifiers are included
- [ ] Local/private files remain under ignored paths
- [ ] Logs, screenshots, and PR text do not reproduce private payloads

See [`docs/security/private-data-policy.md`](../docs/security/private-data-policy.md).
